effectiveCondition: This record is effective only after owner-reviewed merge to main and execution from an exact tracked-clean local main equal to freshly fetched origin/main.

approvalAuthority.requestBasis: The repository owner directed progression after PR 86 while preserving physical-device-first sequencing before the remaining source queue.

read and verify the exact governed Build 6 package and embedded APK
extract the exact embedded APK into a private evidence directory
read package, version, minimum SDK and production-signer metadata
read one ADB target's state, API level, physical-device properties and Google Play Services presence
verify that the CRM-III package is absent from the candidate target

launch the CRM-III application or interact with device UI

read or write Firestore, Realtime Database, Storage or business data
approve, revoke or alter any user or role
deploy or mutate Firebase, Rules, Functions, IAM or App Check

pilot handout, second-device use, external upload or public distribution
claim DEVICE_PROVED, close STAGE2D-F4 or close P-07
